S.locator_convention: S:L identifies a 1-based line in the supplied text extraction.

R.locator_convention: Page numbers are printed report pages; headings and paragraph numbers identify the passage.

interpretation.new_ids: Exact source strings, including general-electorate leading zeroes; Māori IDs remain unpadded.
interpretation.old_ids: Continuing predecessor seats and additional contributors expressly named in the report; not an exhaustive polygon-intersection concordance.
interpretation.relationships: Explicit same-seat name changes are renamed. The five reconfigured replacement seats are provisionally created; their six replaced predecessors receive abolished records. See ambiguity A1.
interpretation.notes: Report sentences or bullet wording, with whitespace normalized and terminal punctuation added where needed.
interpretation.review_fields: Requested reviewer and date are proposed attribution, not evidence that supervisor review has occurred.
interpretation.no_weighting: No population weights, vote transfers, or authority to sum predecessor election totals.

ambiguities.A1: The executive summary calls these electorates replaced/reconfigured, but groups all ten new names under Name changes; paragraph 93 also uses renamed broadly. Created/abolished is a provisional translation into the requested taxonomy, requiring supervisor confirmation.
ambiguities.A2: Schedule B expressly marks Taupō changed, but the supplied report narrative does not identify its specific boundary movement. No locality transfer or donor seat is inferred.

supervisor_resolutions.A1: Accepted. Replaced/reconfigured seats with no continuing name are recorded as created (five) with their predecessor old_ids, and the six predecessors with no successor of the same name as abolished. The report's own words are quoted in each note (executive summary p7 to p9; paragraphs 46 and 50). Renamed is reserved for seats the report says are renamed (East Cape, Mt Maunganui, Ōtāhuhu, Wellington Bays, Wellington North).
supervisor_resolutions.A2: Accepted. Taupō stays boundary_changed on Schedule B's authority; the note says the report narrative does not describe the movement. No donor seat is inferred.
supervisor_resolutions.counts: Schedule B: 15 unchanged and 49 changed general, 4 unchanged and 3 changed Māori. Draft: unchanged 18 plus renamed East Cape with unchanged boundaries equals 19; boundary_changed 43 plus 4 renamed with changes plus 5 created equals 52. Totals agree.
